pages.title: A Frothy Tale
pages.text: Connect farming and drying to a real brew.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Prepare hops, dried grain, water and heat according to the recipe; follow the brewing prompts and collect the drink with a Mug.

pages.title: Grow brewing hops
pages.text: Look for wild hops in taiga, then grow them beneath rope. Silo-dried grain is a separate part of the brewing recipe.

pages.title: Tend a Brewingstation
pages.text: Fill the kettle with water, add ingredients, fuel the oven and answer its prompts. Handling them affects quality and yield.

pages.title: Handle failed brewing
pages.text: Overflow and missed prompts can spoil brewing and release a hostile creature. Learn to prevent failure; deliberately causing it is not required.
